episodes.title: The Stuff That Dreams Are Made Of
episodes.summary: Four brothers set out to build a movie studio from the ground up while making a giant leap from silent films to talkies. As the Warners stand up to WWII Nazism, personal ambitions lead to family betrayal.
episodes.imageAlt: The Stuff That Dreams Are Made Of

episodes.title: Clint, Kubrick & Kryptonite
episodes.summary: After a historic sale, Warner Bros. navigates the upheavals of the ‘60s and ‘70s. Under a new strategist CEO, the company enters an era of unmatched storytelling with groundbreaking projects.

episodes.title: Heroes, Villains and Friends
episodes.summary: In the ‘80s, a new generation helps crown Warner Bros. as a forerunner in Hollywood's blockbuster age. After a historic merger, the company becomes one of the biggest entertainment giants in the world.

episodes.title: Wizarding World and The Big Bang
episodes.summary: The 21st century is the time of new business partnerships and company mergers. Warner Bros. continue to champion authentic voices and adopt the latest digital technology.
